title: Varda footer
description: A navy footer framed by the page grid's dashed side hairlines: icon and wide wordmark, small uppercase dusty-blue labels over the address and contact lines, a row of line icons for socials; link groups in two columns from the middle (one column holds two groups); a dashed rule, then small copyright and legal links. Links underline on hover.
notes: best on dark themes; labels use muted-foreground, hairlines border
